text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language, recognizing images, or making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of being programmed with exact rules. Deep learning goes further, using complex networks inspired by the human brain to process vast amounts of information, enabling tasks like voice recognition. You likely use AI every day: virtual assistants like Siri, recommendation systems on streaming services, spam filters in email, and even navigation apps that predict traffic. These tools learn from your behavior, becoming more helpful over time. While AI may sound futuristic, it is already woven into the fabric of modern life, quietly working behind the scenes to save you time and effort.
